description: The saved session of every model actor of the run

^.*$.description: The conversation of one actor with its model, without the system text the game gives again and without a key

declared.description: Every tool declared to the model when the session was saved, in the order declared

format.description: The version of the saved session format

initial.description: The tools of the leading system message, in its order: the tools open when the session started

messages.description: The conversation after the leading system message, in order

items.description: One message as JSON text, with the key order the session held

notice.description: The open tools the last tools notice named; left out: no notice since the start or the last context reset
